card.name: Key adjectives in legal and rights argument
card.fires_on: Qualifying words in abstract legal or philosophical argument, such as negative, positive, any, ends, new, compelling, useful. It fires on the word that sets up the noun that follows, such as rights, duty, evidence or interests.
